deviations: Layercake.usp_load_brnz_subs_status and the brnz_subs_status table file keep the Phase 1 lower-case keyword style and constraint names (df_/pk_brnz_subs_status_*) rather than base standards 2.1/upper-case keywords: the module changes as little as the behaviour needs and follows the code around it. The sqlfluff capitalisation findings come from this and are left as they are.
notes:
MOD-017 adds inv_total_amount numeric(38,6) NULL and retired_concession varchar(17) NULL to Layercake.brnz_subs_status through a change script (src/sql/changes/MOD-017). ALTER TABLE ADD puts them after the audit columns, and the table file lists them in that order. The down script drops both columns and restores the Phase 1 procedure.

usp_load_brnz_subs_status now lands 'Inv Total Amount' and 'Retired Concession' 1:1 and includes them in its EXCEPT change test, so a change to or from NULL counts as a change. retired_concession is compared as varbinary(17), so a source change that differs only in case or trailing spaces is landed too, because the case-insensitive collation would hide it. The key, the row_number duplicate guard, insert, soft delete and restore, the row-count check and the logging are unchanged.

The first run after deployment updates every live row once to fill the new columns. A rerun on unchanged source then logs 0/0/0.

Starting point: 2 of 9 Tester tests passed and 7 failed (invalid column inv_total_amount). Now all 9 Tester tests and all 4 dev tests pass: case and trailing-space change, duplicate source key tie-break, restore and delete counts, and the error path rolling back a part-done load. The round-trip passes.

Test-first: the first run had 2 of 9 of the Tester's tests passing; the final run passed 9 of 9 and 4 unit test(s), in 3 run(s).
